tickets.title: Define provision identity, typed action lineage, and reproducible authority arithmetic
tickets.goal: Extend the existing legal-reconciliation owner so every law-to-money path starts from a version-specific provision, carries truthful action-to-fact lineage, and uses reproducible fiscal arithmetic.
tickets.acceptance: KS-600 is amended before implementation with a shared provision-reference definition and checkable reconciliation rules. Source-backed cases demonstrate provision identity independent of numbering/evidence coordinates, existing typed derivation reuse without Cartesian edge inference, reviewed account resolution, allowed fiscal field combinations, and reproducible authority calculations without double counting or invented zero values.
acceptance_checks: Define a version-specific provision reference separating canonical identity, legal instrument/version, displayed section/subsection numbering, source revision/span coordinates, observation dates, and effective dates. Re-extraction does not change legal identity; cross-version continuity requires evidenced lineage; unsupported effective dates remain unknown. State explicitly that the provision ID capability is currently missing and SourceSpan-as-entity-ID is superseded as a requirement, not already fixed runtime behavior.

Reuse derivation.schema.json typed inputs/outputs {type, id, revision_or_hash}, input/output set hashes, and derivation run context for appropriation-action to fiscal-fact lineage. Do not add appropriation_action_id to fiscal facts or a second lineage table. Demonstrate a multi-input/multi-output case where joint derivation membership does not imply every action maps one-to-one to every fact; stronger edges require explicit supported correspondence.

Keep appropriation_action.action_type as the legal operation, fiscal_fact.stage as context, metric as measured value, and evidence_class as the assertion character. Preserve existing enums; define allowed/invalid combinations, stage overlap and evidence-class precedence including official publishers of observed, modeled, or calculated values. Allow fiscal facts with no appropriation action when supported.

Specify exact decimal/null/no-limit semantics, conditions, direction, periods, veto/override and bounded amendment effects. Define reproducible snapshot selection and authority arithmetic through supported fiscal facts/derivations; never total an action amount together with its linked fact. Keep changes, balances, period flows, transfer legs, authority and expenditure separate; declare consolidation boundaries; missing or incomplete sources never imply zero.

Consume KS-595 source/span registration, KS-597 exact field anchors, and KS-601 reviewed effective-dated account crosswalks. Preserve agency/FY/code-system scope, unknown subunit, ambiguity, and unknown matches; equal labels or normalized codes alone cannot establish identity. Generalization needs source/configuration/review, not bill-specific parser branches.

Use retained source revisions and exact legal evidence for accepted records, including enacted Session Law provisions where appropriate. Current statutes may establish standing authority, definitions or evidenced lineage; unresolved History references are not resolved edges and cannot replace the uncodified appropriation act.
proposed_contracts_to_ground: Version-specific provision-reference definition owned by KS-600; wave 2 must distinguish its proposed path/signature from existing code.
existing_owner_prerequisites: Exact fiscal field evidence from KS-597
Reviewed account crosswalk records from KS-601
out_of_scope: New action ID field on fiscal facts
Runtime changes in this planning turn
materialization_notes: Amend existing KS-600, reported proposed at handoff, retaining its existing responsibility and history. Add bounded support owner pointers to KS-595/597/601; do not promote them into rival packages.
Actual source-backed implementation verification belongs to the resulting ticket; this artifact does not assert populated provision, action, or arithmetic producers.

Keep existing document/custody records compatible, including redistribution, license_profile, custody_status, lifecycle current/superseded/corrected/withdrawn and removal_required. Define the second record type with canonical identity and revision, typed relationships, typed derivation references and run context, exact structured fiscal fields, evidence references, eligibility/lifecycle, and deterministic source-derived semantic descriptions. Golden compatibility fixtures and repeat export comparisons prove stable record dispatch, unchanged document-record acceptance, deterministic description/delta output, lifecycle transitions, source revision tracking, structured evidence, and rejection/withholding of records missing their own prerequisites.

tickets.title: Combine exact and semantic retrieval with validated typed traversal
tickets.goal: Answer scoped law-to-money questions through exact identifiers and semantic candidates that resolve to upstream canonical facts and supported typed paths.
tickets.acceptance: One existing retrieval pipeline exposes provider-free exact/lexical, document-semantic, entity-description-semantic, hybrid and hybrid-plus-graph modes. Source-backed positives produce cited fiscal answers after canonical validation and bounded typed traversal; wrong-year, ambiguous, incomplete or unsupported paths remain explicit. Money and action semantics come from upstream fiscal facts/derivations, not retrieved passage totals or vector joins.
acceptance_checks: Use existing retrieval/ranking seams for exact bill/chapter/KSA/agency/fund/account identifiers and natural-language aliases. Exact/lexical baseline and outage fallback bypass both embedding and remote reranking calls. Evaluate existing configured providers in ExAIS scope; add no provider or parallel retriever.

Semantic document and compact entity-description matches only propose candidates. Validate canonical identity, source/audience eligibility, requested FY/as-of, agency/fund/account scope, exact structured values and legal action role before bounded allowlisted typed traversal and citation hydration.

Traverse the upstream-validated enacted provision to appropriation action to fiscal-year account to agency/fund path and attached evidence with explicit source/snapshot/run provenance. Preserve joint derivation lineage and do not assert one-to-one action/fact correspondence unless explicitly supported. Do not create edges from semantic similarity, statute History references, matching section numbers or account-code normalization.

Hydrate numeric answers from canonical fiscal records and KS-600 reproducible derivations/snapshot policy. Keep action_type, stage, metric and evidence_class distinct. Never sum snippets, count linked action/fact amounts twice, combine incompatible balances/flows/transfer legs, infer zero from incomplete coverage, or classify upstream facts independently.

Cite exact legal spans or structured record evidence appropriate to each claim, disclose requested period and source/graph snapshot, and distinguish authority from actual expenditure. Return supported positive paths; disclose ambiguity/gaps and decline unsupported arithmetic rather than treating every unknown as zero or passing by refusing everything.

Query each store using its configured embedding profile. Federate only explicitly allowed canonical-ID/snapshot paths; no automatic cross-store expansion, equal-dimension requirement, raw-score comparison across profiles, free-form SQL/Cypher or global policy change.

Focused tests cover provider/reranker bypass, exact-code preservation, natural-language candidate recall, separate retrieval modes, structured validation, typed path direction/provenance, joint-derivation limits, source/ACL isolation, source-backed numeric/citation correctness, and explicit ambiguity/no-path behavior.

Report candidate recall/ranking, complete correct path/answer rate, monetary/FY/source/citation correctness, refusal and no-path quality, audience/eligibility leakage, stale/withdrawn leakage, latency, embedding calls and storage/embedding cost.

Require positive source-backed answers across the diversity matrix and on the unseen positive bill/agency case. No post-hoc denominator exclusions, inherited pilot numeric constants, generic-keyword passes or all-refusal success. Keep failures visible, deduplicate repeated source/extraction evidence and distinguish retrieval success from answer correctness.

Set and enforce a predeclared material graph improvement criterion over semantic-only on both development/tuned and held-out groups, alongside no exact-identifier regression and hard correctness/leakage gates. Provider/profile comparisons stay within existing ExAIS provider scope and record their actual configuration/cost.

Verify that candidate records cannot leak through ordinary semantic retrieval with graph expansion disabled and that lifecycle removals and wrong-scope/source-snapshot cases cannot pass through exact retrieval, expansion or citations. Test multi-input derivation cases without fabricated pairwise edges and arithmetic without action/fact double counting.

Run reproducibility checks from the same frozen inputs and report legitimate variability. Synthetic tests remain mechanics/security proof. Produce a reviewed/versioned report with reproducible source-backed expected numeric answers/derivations and held-out evaluation evidence suitable for WAVE-132 activation gating.
